units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 11:6:2">Y. Ned. XI, 42ᵈ</cite> <he>קונם תאנה</he> … <he>ועוד ע׳</he> I swear that I will not taste figs and furthermore (after thirty days) grapes.—Pl. <he>עֲנָבִים</he>, <he>עֲנָבִין</he>; const. <he>עִנְּבֵי</he>, <cite ref="P00072"><he>עִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:12">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> <he>סחטה ע׳ וכ׳</he> she (Eve) pressed grapes and gave him the juice to drink.

<cite ref="Pesachim 49a:7">Pes. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>משל לע׳ הגפן בע׳ הגפן</he> (a marriage between a scholar and a scholar’s daughter is) like bunches of grapes combined with bunches of grapes; <he>לע׳ הגפן בע׳ הסנה</he> (a scholar married to an ignorant man’s daughter is) like a bunch of grapes with berries of thorns.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 99a:16">Snh. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>יין המשומר בעֲנָבָיו מששת וכ׳</he> wine preserved in its grapes from the six days of creation (future reward of scholars); <cite ref="Berakhot 34b:32">Ber. 34ᵇ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:2">Succ. III, 2</cite> <he>ענביו מרובות מעליו</he> if the berries on the myrtle exceed its leaves; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:2">Bekh. VI, 2</cite> <he>ועֵינָב</he> (Ar. <he>וענב</he>; Bab. ed. 38ᵃ <he>עצב</he>, corr. acc.); ib.ᵇ <he>עצב</he> (corr. acc.); Sifra Emor, ch. II, Par. 3 <cite ref="P00622"><he>עֵינָיו</he></cite> (Rab. <he>ענב</he>); v. <cite ref="A01367"><he>אֵינָב</he></cite>.
